assumptions: TABLE 2. The kind registry issues table 2 beside table 1 (not edited); new items are declared under it. Items declared before keep table 1, so a clone item declared before this change does not end at run finished.

THE STORE OF AC4 IS A READER THE CALLER GIVES (held(sha256)). No blob store exists yet, and nothing in production wires one: until it does, only a commit the declared trunk or a kept ref reaches counts as a copy. The trunk is the land entry's (review F1), read through the spool's Local.trunk from `landing`, which the service's consumer passes; a caller that passes none (reconcile, the dispatcher) counts kept refs only.

OLDER SUITES ADAPTED (spec History). Rows of the VELDO-0299, 0300, 0301, 0315 and 0345 suites and the 0298 suite that encoded the behaviour this ticket changes. In 138 and 140 the before_0347 probe is passed only by the rows that plant ignored work or an own-folder repository, each by name (review F6): 138 work/ignored-files, work/worktree-second-probe, work/repository-in-a-folder, work/adopted-build-output; 140 ac4/outside-git, ac5/failed-save-removes-nothing, ac5/kill-points, ac6/removing-put-back, ac4/modes-kept, ac5/folders-synced. Every other row runs the whole chain on the real probe.

SHUT FOLDERS (review F3). A folder beneath scratch or build output that cannot be listed holds the item at rule 6, whoever owns it, as AC2 says. The one exception is a confined run's own scratch (named with the sandbox's SCRATCH_PREFIX and declared with a parent item, VELDO-0324 suite 154 ac2/recorded): there a folder this user owns that refuses only for its permission bits is opened by the folder remover, whose walk stops on any repository that is not a clean clone before anything is deleted. Recorded in the spec History.

SECOND LINES OF DEFENCE. Four falsifiers are caught a step later by an existing check (the worktree remover's last look, the folder remover's walk, the agent repository remover's last look, the ledger's keep record); each such row is red on the rule this ticket adds, and the work is not lost.
The touchpoint request itself is VELDO-0327; here a clone deferred as unique work carries the same decision_request qualifier a worktree does.
